title: Insaani Kankalon Wali Jheel 💀 | Roopkund | Bhootiya Bharat Ep 4
setting: Roopkund glacial lake, Himalayas, Chamoli, Uttarakhand, India
description:
Himalaya mein 16,500 feet par ek jheel… jiske kinare saikdon insaani kankaal pade hain.
Ye log kaun the aur ek saath kaise mare?

#roopkund #mystery #BhootiyaBharat

scenes.narration: हिमालय में एक झील है... जिसके किनारे सैकड़ों इंसानी कंकाल पड़े हैं।
image_prompts: a small frozen glacial lake high in the snowy Himalayas with scattered old bones on the rocky shore, eerie mist
close view of weathered human bones half buried in snow and rocks by an icy lake
scenes.visual_description: a small frozen glacial lake high in the snowy Himalayas with scattered old bones on the rocky shore, eerie mist

scenes.narration: ये है रूपकुंड... उत्तराखंड में, लगभग 16,500 फ़ीट की ऊँचाई पर।
image_prompts: aerial view of a tiny lake in a bowl of snowy Himalayan peaks above the clouds
a steep rocky mountain trail leading up to a hidden glacial lake, clouds below
scenes.visual_description: aerial view of a tiny lake in a bowl of snowy Himalayan peaks above the clouds

scenes.narration: 1942 में एक फ़ॉरेस्ट रेंजर यहाँ पहुँचा... और उसके होश उड़ गए।
image_prompts: an Indian forest ranger in a 1940s uniform with a backpack reaching a snowy mountain lake, shocked
the ranger's boots stopping beside a skull lying on the snow by the lake
scenes.visual_description: an Indian forest ranger in a 1940s uniform with a backpack reaching a snowy mountain lake, shocked

scenes.narration: बर्फ़ पिघली, तो झील में और चारों ओर हड्डियाँ ही हड्डियाँ थीं।
image_prompts: melting ice revealing hundreds of bones and skulls around a turquoise glacial lake
bones visible under clear shallow icy water, sunlight on the surface
scenes.visual_description: melting ice revealing hundreds of bones and skulls around a turquoise glacial lake

scenes.narration: पहले लोगों को लगा, ये दूसरे विश्व युद्ध में फँसे जापानी सैनिक हैं।
image_prompts: soldiers in 1940s uniforms struggling through a Himalayan blizzard, silhouettes in snow
an old 1940s military map and compass on a table, dramatic light
scenes.visual_description: soldiers in 1940s uniforms struggling through a Himalayan blizzard, silhouettes in snow

scenes.narration: पर जाँच में पता चला... ये कंकाल सैकड़ों साल पुराने हैं।
image_prompts: scientists in a lab examining an ancient skull under bright light, bones laid out on a table
carbon dating samples and old bones in labelled trays, laboratory
scenes.visual_description: scientists in a lab examining an ancient skull under bright light, bones laid out on a table

scenes.narration: कई खोपड़ियों पर गहरी चोटें मिलीं... जैसे ऊपर से क्रिकेट बॉल जितने ओले गिरे हों।
image_prompts: a violent hailstorm with huge hailstones falling on travellers on a Himalayan pass, dark sky
giant hailstones the size of cricket balls bouncing on rocks and snow
scenes.visual_description: a violent hailstorm with huge hailstones falling on travellers on a Himalayan pass, dark sky

scenes.narration: 2019 की DNA जाँच ने सबको चौंका दिया... कुछ लोग भूमध्यसागर इलाके के निकले।
image_prompts: a glowing DNA double helix over a map connecting the Himalayas to the Mediterranean sea
ancient travellers from distant lands walking toward snowy Himalayan peaks
scenes.visual_description: a glowing DNA double helix over a map connecting the Himalayas to the Mediterranean sea

scenes.narration: ये लोग इतनी दूर यहाँ क्यों आए... और कैसे मरे? आज भी कोई नहीं जानता।
image_prompts: the lonely skeleton lake at twilight surrounded by snowy peaks and mist, nobody there
a single skull on a rock facing the frozen lake under a starry sky
scenes.visual_description: the lonely skeleton lake at twilight surrounded by snowy peaks and mist, nobody there
